frozen_data_file: never_analysed_reserve.csv.gz, the name of the frozen data file in the hash record: all 442 frozen pairs of Set A, the first out-of-array evaluation set (not released)
release_rule: A pair of the frozen file is released, with all its measurements, when it is a record-transfer target of the frozen evaluation (the pairs of results/reserve_validation/record_transfer_losses.csv), a target of its three-condition decision (the pairs of results/reserve_validation/decision_targets.csv) or an amide-coupling pair (array Acylation|1) whose best measured yield is at least 0.10. The other pairs of the frozen file serve no reported result and are not released.
